Administering KoldFusion Server

Debugging

The Debug Settings page controls the debugging information that KoldFusion adds to the bottom of each page and to error messages, and who gets to see it.

Go there: Open the Debugging page (or inside the frameset)

Option Default In KoldFusion
Enable performance monitoring off Cosmetic; there is no performance monitor to feed
Enable CFML stack trace off Cosmetic; CFCATCH.TagContext is always filled in
Show variables off Real. Lists the URL, form, client, cookie and CGI variables under each page.
Show processing time off Real. Shows the total time to process the page.
Detail View off Real. Adds the time spent in each template (needs Show processing time).
Show SQL and data source name on Real. Database error messages include the SQL statement and data source name.
Show query information off Real. Lists each query with its record count, time and SQL.
Display the template path in error messages on Real. Error messages include the full template path.

Debug output is added only to HTML pages, and only when at least one of Show variables, Show processing time or Show query information is checked. A template can turn it off for itself with CFSETTING SHOWDEBUGOUTPUT="No", and IsDebugMode tells a template whether debug output is on.

Restrict debug output to selected IP addresses

Type an IP address and click Add to put it on the list. Select addresses and click Remove to take them off. When the list is empty, every visitor sees the debug output. When it has entries, only those addresses do. Add 127.0.0.1 to keep the output to yourself while you work on the server machine.

Note  On a production server, turn off Show SQL and the template path. Your visitors do not need to know your table names or where your files live.
